snippet.title: A small talk at the back of beyond Full Playthrough / Longplay / Walkthrough (no commentary)
snippet.description:
Longplay / complete playthrough of A small talk at the back of beyond, a short indie adventure / interactive fiction by scriptwelder featuring a text parser interface, recorded by Gryvix, published 27 October 2017. 

A small talk at the back of beyond release date:
- Flash: 5 March 2013

Play A small talk at the back of beyond for free:
- Newgrounds: https://www.newgrounds.com/portal/view/612685
- Gamejolt: https://gamejolt.com/games/a-small-talk-at-the-back-of-beyond/15533

- https://youtu.be/C37V_ON45dM
